notes.note: #0.98-111 are a 14-slot leader block (+97+k; #0.98 is in story_089). Pt_Chara_Check order 11,12,14,15,5,4,3,2,1,6,7,10,9,8 = Ultraman, Seven, Mebius, Zero, OOO, W, Den-O, RX, Rider 1, Nu, Zeta, 00, Wing Zero, God Gundam; wording fits (#0.99 watashi = Seven, identical to #0.98; #0.100 boku + 'Taro-niisan' = Mebius; #0.103 Shotaro; #0.104 Momotaros). The same order also fits #0.10-23 in story_089. Identical Japanese kept identical.
Mebius's 'Taro-niisan' rendered 'Brother Taro' (glossary honorific rule for Ultra brothers).
'Warui koto wa iwanee' = 'I'm telling you for your own good' (Shotaro's tough-but-caring voice).
Alternate version of the Plasma Spark scene (#0.71/#0.73 in story_089). 'Energy core' kept lowercase as in earlier slices.
??? speaker (CHARA_NAME 30), the unseen mastermind watching; second version of #0.84-88. Refers to the heroes in third person, then addresses Master Gundam. Singular 'I' assumed for the speaker.
Ankh (CHARA_NAME 36). 'Dai 3 sou' rendered 'Floor 3' to match the established floor naming.

#0.1-14 leader block (+1+k). Pt_Chara_Check order W, OOO, RX, Rider 1, Den-O, Zero, Mebius, Ultraman, Seven, Taro, Nu, Zeta, God, Wing Zero, 00 (15 slots, 14 rows). Wording fits: #0.2 soft (OOO), #0.5 rough 'mitee' (Momotaros). Identical rows kept identical.
Deliberate two-line sign layout kept with a line break. 'Kaijin' = Kamen Rider monsters (as in 'revived kaijin'), 'kaiju' = Ultra monsters.

#0.4-32 (even rows) leader block. Order OOO, W, Den-O, RX, Rider 1, Zero, Mebius, Ultraman, Seven, Taro, Nu, Zeta, God, Wing Zero, 00. #0.6 (W/Philip) says the enemy MADE Gaoh's gang collect them (causative kept); #0.8 Momotaros. 'Gaoh ichimi' = 'Gaoh's gang' (earlier slices call him a robber-gang boss); #0.4 'Gaoh-tachi' = 'Gaoh and his crew'.

Monster plates: Ultra titles from the established English (Full Moon Choju Lunaticks, Ancient Monster Gomora, Space Monster Eleking); glossary 'Choju' for chouju. The Shocker kaijin have no title in the source.
'Unlock it?' made explicit as 'Unlock the cage?' (object implied by the scene).
Gomora roar reuses the established 'Gwaaaaaaaaah!!' (story_049); Zanjioh uses the Shocker kaijin cry 'Igiiiiiiih!!'. Lunaticks, Gebacondor and Eleking cries are new (romanized by sound).

report: All 80 rows translated. Leader blocks mapped from Pt_Chara_Check order (0463 #0.98-111, 0501, 0502) and checked against wording. Uncertain: #0.125-128 ??? speaker assumed to be the unseen mastermind; new roars for Lunaticks/Gebacondor/Eleking. Not in glossary: monster titles (Full Moon Choju, Ancient Monster, Space Monster), 'Gaoh's gang'.
